segments.heading: Three phrases at the counter
segments.body: お願いします (onegaishimasu) is the request you make when ordering. ありがとうございます (arigatou gozaimasu) is the thanks you give as you leave. さようなら (sayounara) is the farewell you say when you leave a shop. All three are standard polite forms.
segments.short: Onegaishimasu requests, arigatou gozaimasu thanks, sayounara says farewell.

segments.heading: Why register and timing matter
segments.body: The greeting opens the interaction and comes before any order; if the staff greet you first, answer in kind. The register with staff you have not met is the standard polite one, while casual forms belong with friends. The opening phrase is the standard daytime greeting: it is neither the request, nor the thanks, nor the farewell, so you can tell it apart from the phrases you already know. Grounding note: SRC_ALPHA supports the greeting wording above; the register rule and the request, thanks and farewell phrases are unverified in this recorded sample, so check them with a teacher before relying on them.
segments.short: The greeting opens the interaction and is not the request, thanks or farewell. The register rule is unverified in this sample.

segments.heading: Tell the greeting apart
segments.body: At the check you will see three phrases. Two of them are functions you already know from this section: the thanks and the farewell. Set those two aside. The remaining phrase is the standard daytime greeting for entering, so that is the one to choose. Read each phrase silently with the romaji visible; no recording ships with this sample, and the romaji is a scaffold, not evidence of reading.
segments.short: At the check, set aside the thanks and the farewell; the remaining phrase is the greeting.

worked_example.prompt: You walk into a café and the staff look up. Which phrase opens the interaction politely?
steps: Notice the moment: you are entering and greeting, before ordering or leaving
Set aside the thanks and the farewell, because neither one opens an interaction
Choose the remaining phrase: it is the standard daytime greeting
worked_example.answer: the remaining phrase, the standard daytime greeting
worked_example.short: Entering is a greeting moment; set the thanks and farewell aside, then choose the remaining phrase.
